name: PayRupik Instant Personal Loan
description:
PayRupik is an online instant personal loan platform trusted by over 10 million users, providing quick access to credit through a simple and secure digital process.
PayRupik is a lending product of Sayyam Investments Pvt Ltd, a Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC) duly registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). Through the PayRupik app, eligible users can avail personal loans of up to ₹2,50,000 through a fully digital and convenient process.
If you are looking for a reliable partner to help manage short term financial needs without complicated procedures, PayRupik is here to help.
Loan Details
Loan Amount: Up to ₹2,50,000
Loan Tenure: 91 days to 180 days
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 35.04%

Interest and other charges are calculated based on the approved loan terms and tenure for the borrower. The final repayment amount, including interest and applicable charges, will be clearly displayed to the user before confirming the loan agreement within the app.
Why Choose PayRupik
Transparency
PayRupik offers instant digital loans with clear information about loan terms and charges.
Instant Personal Loan
Loan amounts are transferred directly to your bank account once approved. The process is fully digital and can be completed anytime.
Efficient Process
Apply for a loan through a quick and simple application flow without physical paperwork.
Security
Your data is protected and transmitted through secure HTTPS connections. Information is never shared without your consent except where required by lenders or regulations.
What Should You Do First
1.	Download and install the PayRupik App
2.	Create an account using your mobile number
3.	Upload your KYC documents, including PAN card and address proof
4.	Complete verification and submit your loan application
Eligibility
You must be an Indian national
You must be more than 20 years of age
You must have a steady monthly source of income
Representative Loan Example
Loan Amount: ₹10,000
Loan Tenure: 120 days
Processing Fee: 4%
GST on Processing Fee: 18%
Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 35.04%
Monthly Percentage Rate: 2.92%
Daily Percentage Rate: 0.096%
Interest Amount: ₹1,152 = ₹10,000 × 35.04% × (120 / 365) 
Processing Fee: ₹400 = ₹10,000 × 4%
GST on Processing Fee: ₹72 = ₹400 × 18%
Total Charges: ₹1,624 = ₹1,152 + ₹400 + ₹72
Total Repayment Amount: ₹11,624 = ₹10,000 + ₹1,624
Important Disclaimer
Loan approval, loan amount, interest charges, and tenure are subject to credit assessment and may vary based on the applicant’s profile and risk evaluation.
PayRupik does not guarantee loan approval. All loans are provided at the sole discretion of the lending partner as per applicable regulations.
Contact Us
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us:
Email: service@payrupikloan.in
Phone: 02248930118
Address:
Agyathuri, Chamajali, Amingaon Guwahati Kamrup, Assam 781031

description:
Important Notice: Please note that we do not lend any money through our app, The app is designed only to existing customers to get details about their existing loans, EMIs, and repayment schedules 


Vizzve microseva foundation section 8 microfinace company, is the provision of financial services to low-income clients or solidarity lending groups including consumers and the self-employed, who traditionally lack access to banking and related services. It is not just about giving micro credit to the poor rather it is an economic development tool whose objective is to assist poor to work their way out of poverty.
 
Should visit our branch to take loan app 

Rates & Charges
Minimum loan amount - Rs 5,000 /-
Maximum loan amount - Rs 1,00,000 /-
Tenure - 90 Days to 365 Days.
Processing fee - 5% to 8% of loan amount.
Rates & Charges
No pre - closure charges
No prepayment charges
ROI (Rate of interest) @ 1.5% to 2.92% Monthly
APR (Annual Percentage Rate) @ 18% to 35%.
Cheque bounce charges: Rs. 1000/-
How is APR determined?
Annual percentage rate (APR) is determined based on your credit score, the amount you wish to borrow and your steady income. Generally, a good CIBIL score calls for a low APR while a poor CIBIL score means high APR.

Working of Our Rates & Fees
APR reflects the true cost of borrowing money. It includes the annual interest rate, a nominal processing fee and other miscellaneous expenses. APR is usually lower than your credit card interest rate. APR is the actual annual cost of your loan that helps you compare various loan offers from different lenders. We have a APR @ 33.6% per annum.

name: TezCredit
description:
TezCredit is a digital lending platform owned by Finagle Financial Services Private Limited. All loans are sanctioned and disbursed solely by our RBI-registered NBFC partner, Finagle Financial Services Private Limited (RBI Registration No: N-14.03528).

Looking for an reliable loan app to meet urgent expenses? TezCredit is your trusted solution for quick personal loans, directly credited to your bank account. Whether it’s for medical bills, rent, shopping, education, travel, or emergencies- TezCredit makes borrowing simple and reliable. With a 100% digital application process, you can apply anytime, anywhere without paperwork. The app is designed for fast approval, transparent charges, and secure processing giving you complete peace of mind. TezCredit is the hassle free way to get a quick loan online when you need it most.

Our NBFC details

description: Pocketly–Your Go-To Instant personal loan app! Need a quick loan? Say goodbye to long bank queues & endless paperwork! Welcome to Pocketly, the ultimate instant personal loan app designed to give you financial freedom exactly when you need it. Whether you are a student needing tuition fees or a salaried professional facing an end-of-month crunch, Pocketly is the secure online loan solution you have been waiting for. With the Pocketly money app, credit is just a tap away. We offer a seamless experience that lets you get credit up to ₹50,000. Our smart technology ensures that once your KYC is approved, the loan amount is disbursed into your account within seconds! Why Choose Pocketly? We understand that financial needs can be urgent. That is why our quick loan process is designed for speed & simplicity - Zero Physical Documentation: Complete your KYC online. No paper forms, no fuss. Everything is 100% digital - Lightning-Fast Disbursal: Get cash in your bank account in seconds after KYC approval Key Features: - Credit up to ₹50,000: Get instant access to funds from small amounts up to ₹50,000 anytime - Instant Disbursal: Complete your 100% online KYC in minutes on our instant personal loan app. Once verified, your quick loan is transferred immediately to your account - Flexible Repayment Plans: Repay on your own terms! Choose a payback period of 61 days to 9 Months. Our interest rates are affordable, starting from just 2% to 3% per month Digital Gold Savings Discover diverse investment opportunities with our 24k digital gold plan. Invest one-time or through SIPs—daily, weekly, or monthly—starting from just ₹10. Enjoy secure returns, no storage hassles, instant redemption & zero hidden charges. Who is Pocketly Money App For? - Students: Do you need extra cash for books, exams or a trip? Pocketly is the perfect student loan companion to keep your studies & lifestyle on track - Salaried Professionals: Facing an unexpected medical bill/utility expense? Use our quick loan feature to bridge the gap until payday - Self-employed Professionals: Need urgent funds to cover small business expenses? Our loan assist feature provides the backup you need, instantly Transparent Fees & Charges Transparency is the core of our loan assistance promise. - Interest Rates: 2% to 3% per month - APR: 30% to 132% - Processing Fees: 0% - 7.5% (GST extra as applicable) - Tenure: 61 days to 9 months Representative Loan Example Here is how our online loan calculation works: Loan Amount: ₹5,000 Tenure: 90 Days Interest Rate: 36% per annum Processing Fee: As applicable (assumed small fee for calculation) Calculation: Interest = ₹5,000 x 36% x 90/365 = ₹443.8 Total Repayment Amount: ₹5,000 (Principal) + ₹443.8 (Interest) = ₹5443.8 (Note: GST & processing fees will be extra as applicable) Lending NBFC Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. (CIN: U65920MH1995PTC090558). Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. is a RBI registered NBFC. Speel Finance Company Pvt. Ltd. provides the loans as well as owns & operates the digital lending platform application Pocketly. Take Control of Your Finances Today! Get access to funds exactly when you need them. Whether you need a student loan for college expenses, loan assistance to manage monthly budgets or a quick loan for a medical emergency, we are here. Join thousands of satisfied users who have made Pocketly their preferred online loan partner. Experience a true instant personal loan app where money reaches you in a flash. Contact Us If you have any queries or need help with our loan application, please reach out: care@support.pocketly.in We store & analyze the transactional SMSs present on the users device to assess his/her credit worthiness. name: Kissht: Instant Personal Loans
description:
Kissht is a trusted digital loan app by 60+ million Indians for Instant personal loans and flexible business loans tailored to their personal and business financial needs. Whether you are salaried or self-employed, Kissht offers both personal loans and business loans to provide immediate financial assistance

Kissht Personal Loan Offerings
● Loan Amount - ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,000
● Interest rates - Starting from 1% per month
● Tenure - 6 to 60 months
● APR Range (Min-Max): 17%–45%*

Why Choose Kissht Digital Lending App

1. Kissht Offers Personal loans for Salaried & Self-Employed Individuals. The loan ranges from ₹5,000 to ₹5,00,000, with 100% digital processing, minimal documentation, Flexible EMI repayment options, and the lowest interest rate among other NBFCs, and instant loan approval in 5 mins with same-day loan disbursal.

✔️ Personal Loan for all use cases:

👉 Personal Loan for Students/ Education Fund
👉 Personal Loan for Medical Emergency or Medical bills
👉 Personal Loan for Debt Consolidation
👉 Personal Loan for Wedding Expenses
👉 Personal Loan for Home Repairs
👉 Personal Loan for Travel

2. Kissht provides tailored business loan designed for entrepreneurs. It offers business loans from ₹5,000 to ₹5,00,000 with 100% Digital KYC, Zero Paperwork, Affordable interest rate with Flexible Tenure Ranges, and Flexible EMI repayment plan

✔️ Business Loan for all use cases:

👉 Business Loan for MSME Owners
👉 Business Loan for Startup Companies
👉 Business Loan for Small Business Owner
👉 Business Loan for E-Commerce startups
👉 Business Loan for Manufacturers

Example of Unsecured Personal Loan
Loan amount (Sanctioned): ₹ 1,25,000.
Tenure: 24 months.
Interest Rate: 33% per annum.
Processing Fee (incl. GST): ₹ 8,850.
Total Interest: ₹ 47,467.
EMI: ₹ 7,184.
APR: 41 %.
Sanctioned Loan amount is ₹ 1,25,000.
Net Disbursed amount is ₹ 1,16,150.
Total loan repayment amount is ₹ 1,72,416.
Total Cost of the Loan = Interest Amount + Processing Fees = ₹47,467 + ₹8,850 = ₹56,317.

We work with RBI-registered NBFCs. These NBFCs are as follows: 
-Si Creva Capital Services Pvt Ltd
-MAS Financial Services Ltd
-Northern Arc Capital Ltd.
-Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Ltd.
-SMFG India Credit Co. Ltd.   

Steps to apply for Personal Loan & Business Loan?
1. Install Kissht Personal loan app
2. Register with a mobile number
3. Complete 100% digital PAN & KYC process
4. Choose loan amount & tenure
5. Sign online loan agreements from approved NBFCs
6. Provide bank details
7. Request a money transfer to your bank account

Kissht Digital Lending App Features

✔ Instant online loan
✔ 100% Digital process
✔ Flexible EMI Repayment
✔ Low interest rate
✔ Fast loan approval

What Makes Kissht a Unique Digital Loan App?
1. Easy Loan Approval: Get instant loans online with minimal documentation in a fully 100% digital process.
2. Instant Loan Transfer: You can get funds directly disbursed to your bank account.
3. Short Term Loan Amount: 5k, 10k, 15k, 20k, 25k, 30k, 35k, 40k, 45k, 50k Personal Loan
4. Long Term Loan Amount: 1 Lakh, 2 Lakh, 3 Lakh, 4 Lakh, and 5 Lakh Personal Loan
5. Competitive Interest Rates: Enjoy a lower-interest loan with flexible EMI repayment.

Our Commitment to Customer Safety
1. Payment reminders are communicated via registered landline numbers only; we do not use personal or foreign mobile numbers.
2. Payments are collected exclusively through our app or website; we never request payments to personal accounts.
3. Our collection processes adhere to RBI and MeitY guidelines, with all calls monitored to prevent threats or abuse.
4. The Kissht app respects your privacy, does not access your Contacts List, and does not contact your friends or relatives about loan repayments.

Contact Us:
1. Write to care@kissht.com OR call our customer care number on 08044745884 / 08062816309. 
2. Share with us a screenshot or recording of the message or call.  Address: 10th Floor, Tower 4, Equinox Park, LBS Marg, Kurla (West), Mumbai - 400070

name: Sabka Loan
description:
Mahashakti Financiers Ltd is an NBFC registered with  Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and offers instant personal loans through  cutting-edge digital platform.

We provide fast and effortless loan processing, rapid disbursal within 30 minutes, and competitive interest rates, ensuring a hassle-free, fully digital experience.

Our mission is to provide seamless, affordable, and accessible financial solutions to salaried professionals, empowering them to achieve their goals.

We stand out due to our RBI registered NBFC status, ensuring regulatory compliance, innovative technology for efficient loan processing, customer-centric approach, and minimal risk profile ensuring affordable interest rates.

Before availing our services, please review our terms and conditions, interest rates, and fees. Ensure data security and verify our legitimacy.

Representative example

Sabka loan App provides personal loans ranging from INR 5,000 to INR 1,00,000 based on your
requirement
Loan Amount: - 5,000 to 1,00,000
Interest Rate: - Up to 36% per annum
APR: 36% MAX
Age: - 21 to 55 years
APR 36 % Max.
Late payment fee - as applicable (Charged incurred only in case of delayed repayment )
Processing Fee: - Up to 5%
Loan tenure: - 91 days to 365 days
Pre-closure charges – not applicable

Sample Loan Calculation

Loan amount: ₹ 30,000 at interest rate of 30% p.a.
Loan Duration: 3 Months
Total personal loan interest = ₹ 2,250
Processing fees (PF) + GST = ₹ 500 + ₹ 90 = ₹ 590
Total Deductibles (PF + GST): ₹ 590
In-Hand Amount: Loan Amount - Total Deductibles = ₹ 30,000 - 590 = ₹ 29,410
Total repayable Amount (Loan Amount + Interest): ₹ 32,250
Monthly EMI Repayable (Loan Amount + Interest / No of EMI's): ₹ 10,750
PF + GST are deducted upfront during the loan disbursal.

Key Benefits

Fast and effortless loan processing
Rapid disbursal
Competitive interest rates
Hassle-free , Fully digital experience



Eligibility criteria

The following criteria need to be met for the smooth and successful disbursal of the loan:
Should be Indian Citizens.
Must be salaried professionals.
Must have a monthly take home salary of at least INR 30,000/-
Should have a regular credit of salary to a bank account.
Age should be between 25 and 55 years.
Loans of up to 80% of your monthly salary.

Documents required

Salary slip
Bank statements ( latest three months)
Pan card copy
Adhar card copy
Utility bills/Any address proof

Security And Privacy Policy
To guarantee the security of the information shared by our clients, we have a highly secure
and encrypted system. Please read our privacy policy herehttps://www.sabkaloan.com/privacy_policy.php

Terms & Conditions
Sabka Loan is a unit of Mahashakti Financiers Limited (NBFC), which is registered with
the RBI. Please visit https://www.sabkaloan.com/terms-and-conditions.php


Contact Information

 Official Mail ID:- info@sabkaloan.com
 Official Website:-https://www.sabkaloan.com/
 Head Office : First floor plot no 17,Pocket -8 ,Block C , sector 17 , Dwarka , New Delhi - 110075
Registered Office - Kahjuria Complex Ward no 15 Kathua ,Jammu & Kashmir - 184102

True Balance is a secure platform for lending, payments, and financial services dedicated to the mission of "Finance for All." True Balance is a Prepaid Payment Instrument issuing entity, authorised by RBI, which issues Digital Wallet and Gift Wallet, which can be further utilised for recharges, bill payments, fund transfers and payments through wallet interoperability on UPI. The Loan app also provides unsecured Personal Loans through RBI-registered NBFCs, which have been trusted by over 75 million users across the country. Here, you may avail of digital personal loans ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹2,00,000 (Disbursal Amount) for a tenure of a minimum of 6 months to a maximum of 24 months at a low processing fee. 
True Balance also facilitates digital personal loans up to ₹5,00,000 through RBI-registered NBFCs in partnership with our Fintech partners, with flexible tenures ranging from 6 months to 48 months, depending on the lender’s policy.

The APR for all loans disbursed by our NBFC partners and the NBFCs in partnership with our Fintech Partners ranges from 28.8% to 78%.

●Loan: Apply today for a seamless borrowing experience.

●Direct loan disbursal to your bank account

Example Online Loan Calculation:
-Loan Type: Unsecured Personal Loan

Simplify money transfers with UPI-enabled True Balance Wallet (NPCI Approved).
●UPI Features
●Quickly transfers money to anyone, anytime

How to Apply for a Personal Loan?
●Install the True Balance app.

Contact Information

WHY CHOOSE PAYME:
Instant personal loans upto Rs 5 Lakhs
Money disbursed within minutes of approval
100% digital with zero paperwork and no branch visits

TYPES OF LOANS ON PAYME:
Instant loan: quick funds for any personal need upto Rs 5 Lakhs
Salary advance loan: get next month's salary in advance
Payday loan/ Bullet Loan: short-term loan with a simple one-time repayment
Emergency loan: fast cash for urgent and unplanned expenses
Online loan: a full digital application with no branch visit needed
HOW TO GET YOUR INSTANT LOAN ON PAYME:
Download the PayMe app and sign up with your mobile number and email id.
Enter basic details like income, PAN card and bank account
Complete digital KYC in 60 seconds with Aadhaar and a selfie
Get instant loan approval with no waiting and no branch visit
Loan amount credited to your bank account in 2 minutes Apply for an instant personal loan, online loan or cash loan today.
WHO CAN APPLY:
Salaried employees and working professionals
Minimum monthly salary of Rs 20,000
Age between 21 and 58 years
Indian citizen with a valid bank account
First time borrowers
Valid PAN card and Aadhaar required to meet the basics requirements and get instant approval with fast loan disbursal.
REPRESENTATIVE LOAN EXAMPLES:
Bullet Loan: Amount ₹15,000 | Tenure 30 days | ROI 1.8%/month | Processing fee 5% + GST | One-time repayment ₹15,270 | APR 98.19% p.a.

Loan amounts from ₹2000 to ₹5,00,000. Rates vary by borrower profile, tenure and lender. T&Cs apply.
Why PayMe is a Trusted Loan App
PayMe ensures secure digital lending through certified information security, transparent pricing, & partnerships with RBI-regulated financial institutions.

How much can I borrow from PayMe APP? 
Loan amounts range from Rs 2,000 to Rs 5 Lakhs, subject to eligibility.

Within minutes after approval, the amount is credited directly to your bank account.

Yes. PayMe is RBI-compliant and ISO 27001 certified with full 256-bit encryption.

Interest rates range from 18% to 36% per annum, depending on eligibility, and lender terms.
Can I get a loan without a CIBIL score? 
New to Credit customers are welcome to apply. Loan approval is subject to eligibility.
What documents do I need? 
You only need your PAN card, Aadhaar and an active salary bank account.

name: LazyPay: Loan App & Pay Later
description:
Get credit that’s easy, instant and stress-free. With LazyPay, you get a free credit limit upto Rs.10,000 that you can use across 45,000+ online stores and merchants! Just repay the total every 15 or 30 days, interest-free. 


Here’s what you can do on LazyPay:


🛒PayLater
Checkout on your favourite merchants in just one-tap! It’s completely free. No extra charges, no hidden fees. Shop, buy, spend from your credit limit and pay just one single bill every 15 days.
One-tap payments
No OTPs, CVVs or PINs
Repay just once every 15 days
No interest and no hidden charges


★ Get attractive discounts and offers on various merchants like Swiggy, Zomato, Myntra, Zepto and more.


★ A quick, simple KYC makes your experience a lot smoother. If you complete your KYC with us, you can increase your credit limit (upto as much as Rs. 5 lakhs), and get 30 days to repay your dues (that’s double the normal billing period!). In case you’re unable to pay your bill, you’ll also have options to repay your dues in EMIs.


🔌BillPay: Pay Utility Bills
With over 20,000+ supported billers, LazyPay allows you to pay utility bills with your credit limit. Pay electricity, gas, water bills in one-click; recharge FASTag, mobile postpaid, mobile prepaid, landline, DTH and more. Repay in one shot, along with your LazyPay dues, every 15 or 30 days.


🛞 Auto360 
Your all-in-one vehicle management hub. Now you can add your vehicle, track challans, stay ahead of PUC and insurance expiries. Also, renew your vehicle insurance seamlessly—all in one place.


🎁 GiftCards
Now you can purchase vouchers of over 200+ brands like Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart and more on the LazyPay app. Use them to avail discounts ranging upto 30% on your purchases, or share them with your loved ones!


⚡XpressLoan: Instant Personal Loans
LazyPay offers instant personal loans for all your needs, big or small. Get online loans within minutes and use it for anything you want - no questions asked. Our instant personal loans are cash loans where the lump sum amount is transferred to your bank account. The entire process is paperless and 100% digital, for your convenience.
Personal loan interest rates range from 12% to 36% p.a. with EMI tenures from 3 months upto 60 months.


XpressLoans range from Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5 lakh with an Annual Repayment Period (APR) from 3 to 60 months. Percentage rate (APR) between 12% - 36% on a reducing balance basis.


★Sample EMI Calculation★
For a loan amount = Rs 10,000 | Tenure = 6 months @ interest rate of 18%* p.a.
EMI will be = Rs 1,755/- p.m.
Processing fee = Rs. 200
Total Payment = Rs. 10,730
*Interest rate and processing fee may vary.


★ Join over 20 lakh fellow Indians using the LazyPay app everyday to get instant personal loans, and make payments easily.
★ We believe in total transparency and data safety and security. All your information is safe with us.
★ Have questions? Reach out to us anytime at wecare@lazypay.in 


----------
Revolve rates - 36% to 42%. For Revolve there is no period for repayment. It's a monthly rolling feature.
Convert to EMI - 3 month 24% | 6 month 26% Tenure basis - 3 to 6 months.


Declaration
LazyPay is a platform that only facilitates money lending to duly registered NBFCs to users and complies with all applicable laws including RBI’s Fair Practices code. The details of the registered NBFCs who are partnered with us are mentioned below.
PayU Finance India Private Limited (“PayU Finance”)
https://www.payufin.in/

description:
Quid is an AI-powered loan marketplace and aggregator (personal loan app) that connects you with RBI-approved banks & NBFCs to get a business or personal loan. Trusted by 6 Mn+ users, every student, salaried, self-employed & business owner can complete the online personal loan application process in just 59 seconds! With the Quid personal loan app, get instant loan offers from verified lenders with 100% transparency, no hidden charges, low interest rates & fast loan approval. Now, you can make utility bill payments, all in one app.

Quid Personal Loan App Features:

* Quick Loan Application: Apply in just 59 seconds
* 100% Digital: Easy online loan application with minimal documents
* Personal Loan Matchmaker: Tailored personal loan offers from verified lenders
* Trusted Platform: Personal loans from RBI-approved banks & NBFCs
* Fast Loan Approval: Disbursal that won’t take months
* Low Interest Rates: Get competitive interest rates
* Credit Card: Apply to get exclusive benefits
* Flexible Tenures: 3-60 months 
* Easy EMI: Flexible EMI options
* Unsecured Loan: Zero assets at stake
* Bill Payments & Recharges: Easily pay your utility bills (Upcoming feature)

Use the Quid Personal Loan App for:

* Home Renovation Loan: Upgrade your home with our personal loan app
* Medical Loan: Cover medical expenses with easy personal loan offers

* Travel Loan: Explore new places with an instant personal loan
* Wedding Loan: Fund your dream wedding with a personal loan
* Shopping Loan: Buy your desired products with a personal loan
* Education Loan: Finance your education with the Quid personal loan app
* Consumer Durable Loan: Buy home appliances with a quick personal loan

Repayment Timelines, APR and Transparent Processing Fees & GST:

* Interest rates start from 1% to 3% per month, corresponding to a maximum APR of 12% to 36%*
* The repayment tenure ranges from 3-60 months
* Processing fees will be charged separately as applicable by the lending partner

Eligibility:

Age: 18-55 years
Eligible: Salaried, Self-employed, and Students
Nationality: Indian

Personal Loan Example:

Loan amount: ₹1,50,000

*Note: These figures are for illustrative purposes only. The final interest rate and APR are subject to the customer’s credit assessment, as evaluated by Quid's Lending Partner(s).

Documents for a Personal or Business Loan:

* Identify Proof: Aadhar card, PAN card, Driver’s license, Passport, Voter ID card
* Address Proof: Aadhar card, Utility bills, Voter ID card, Passport
* Income Proof: Bank account statement, Salary slip (for salaried individuals)

How to Apply for a Personal Loan:

➡️ Download the Quid personal loan app
➡️ Sign-up with mobile/email
➡️ Enter details (personal/professional/business)
➡️ Specify your loan requirements
➡️ Choose from our verified lenders

Our Features
Loan Amount: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 3 Lakhs

Repayment Tenure: 3 to 12 months
Flexible Repayment options
100% Paperless loan application
No guarantors or collateral
No upfront Fees

Loan Eligibility 
Age- 21 to 55 years 
Must be an Indian Citizen
Minimum take home income of 20,000/ month
Bank Account where monthly salary is deposited 
Valid Government Proofs- Aadhaar & PAN Card 
Credit Score- 680+ 
Loan Associated Charges

Documentation charges: 1%
Online Convenience charges ₹200 
Bounce charges ₹500 + GST as applicable
Minimum APR- 26% Maximum APR- 60%

Note: GST charges will be added to the Processing charges, Documentation charges, and Online Convenience charges.

Illustrative calculation of APR Disclosure
Loan amount(Principal)= ₹30,000 
Loan Duration= 180 Days
Interest Rate= 28% p.a. 
Total interest on the personal loan= ₹4,104
Processing charges (5% of the loan amount) + Documentation charges (1% of the loan amount) + Online convenience (₹200)= ₹2,000
Total Deductions (Processing charges + Documentation charges + Online convenience + GST) = ₹2,360
Net Disbursed Amount= Loan Amount - Total Deductions= ₹27,640
Total Repayable Amount (Loan Amount + Interest) = ₹34,104

PF+DC+GST is deducted upfront during the loan disbursal.

Note: This is an indicative calculation, interest and other charges vary based on your profile.

Download the Lenditt App

Upload your KYC document, including your ID, address proof and PAN card

description:
PocketRupee is an online instant personal loan platform dedicated to providing users with convenient, transparent, and secure credit services. Through a fully digital process, users can complete their loan application and obtain credit support in a short time. The application process is simple and efficient, with no paperwork required. 
All steps, from application to loan agreement confirmation, can be completed directly on your mobile phone. PocketRupee offers flexible loan amounts ranging from INR 3,000 to INR 120,000, supporting a variety of financial needs such as travel, shopping, medical emergencies, and business cash flow requirements.
 
Why Choose PocketRupee?
1. Convenient and Efficient:A fully digital application process that saves time and effort.
2. Safe and Secure:User data is protected with secure encryption and handled in accordance with applicable data protection standards.
3. User-Friendly Experience:A simple and easy-to-use interface designed for a smooth borrowing experience.
 
PocketRupee User Guide
To ensure compliance and fund security, applicants must meet the following basic requirements:
1. Must be an Indian resident aged 18 years or above
2. Must have a valid mobile number and bank account
3. Must provide valid KYC documents (such as PAN, Aadhaar, etc.)
4. Must meet internal credit assessment criteria
 
Loan Products
Loan Amount: INR 3,000 – INR 120,000
Loan Tenure: 91 days – 180 days
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 24%
Processing Fee: Based on the loan amount and tenure
Goods and Services Tax (GST): 18% GST is applicable on the processing fee as per Indian laws and policies.
 
Calculation Example
Loan Amount: INR 10,000Loan Tenure: 120 daysAnnual Interest Rate: 18%
Total Interest Payable:10,000 × 18% × 120 ÷ 365 = INR 592
Processing Fee (1%):10,000 × 1% = INR 100
GST on Processing Fee:100 × 18% = INR 18
Disbursed amount:10,000 - 100 - 18 = INR 9,882
Total Repayment Amount:10,000 + 592 = INR 10,592
Estimated Monthly Payment(average) = INR 2,648APR: (592 + 100 + 18) ÷ 9,882 ÷ 120 × 365 ≈ 21.9%
 
Note: The above example is for illustrative purposes only. Actual loan terms, interest rates, fees, and repayment amounts may vary based on user eligibility, credit assessment, and platform policies.
 
Lending Partners Information
PocketRupee is a digital lending platform operated by PHRENOLOGICAL INFO AUDIT AND APP SOLUTION PRIVATE LIMITED, acting as a Lending Service Provider (LSP).
Loan products available on this platform are provided by the following regulated financial institution:
 
Allen's Housing & Finance Limited
A Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
RBI Reg. No.: B.05.06399
Official website: https://allenhf.in/tel.html
 
How to Use
1. Download and install the PocketRupee App.
2. Register and create an account using your mobile number.
3. Submit the required KYC information (such as identity proof, address proof, PAN card, etc.).
4. After submission, the system will review your application, and the result will be displayed in the app.=
5. Once approved and the loan agreement is confirmed, the loan amount will be disbursed directly to your bank account.
 
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please contact our professional customer support team. We are happy to assist you.
 
Email:support@phrenological.com
Customer Support Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM–6:30 PM
